scenario_description: Deploy additional temporary or relief staff to increase effective staffing coverage for departments with staffing-level risk.
governance_warning: Estimated staffing effect only; assumes temporary staff achieve stated productivity; does not guarantee outcome.

scenario_description: Activate contingency rosters and replacement coverage to mitigate elevated absenteeism rates.
governance_warning: Estimated absenteeism effect only; assumes contingency coverage is accepted and effective; does not guarantee outcome.

scenario_description: Adjust temporary service capacity, redirection, or rescheduling to reduce average patient waiting time.
minimum_data_requirements: kpi_004 baseline available where calculation_status='Calculated'; at least 60% data completeness per department
governance_warning: Partial baseline coverage for kpi_004; waiting-time estimates may be unreliable where baseline is missing; supporting KPI kpi_003 is provisional.

scenario_description: Simultaneous staffing coverage adjustment and patient-flow modification where both workforce and flow risks are present.
eligible_package_condition: scenario_review_priority in ('Required','Recommended') AND dominant_kpi_id in ('kpi_001','kpi_002','kpi_004') AND cross_domain_recommendation=True
minimum_data_requirements: Primary dominant KPI baseline available; supporting KPI baseline partial acceptable
governance_warning: Cross-domain effects are association-based only (Step 2B-4); no validated causal model exists; confidence is reduced.

scenario_description: Reference scenario representing current observed conditions with no intervention assumptions. Required for every scenario-eligible package.
minimum_data_requirements: At least one KPI baseline available for the package
governance_warning: Baseline represents observed historical data only; trend projection assumes stationarity; not a forecast.

scenario_description: Validation-only scenario for packages requiring data confirmation, threshold review, or operational monitoring without direct intervention assumptions.
governance_warning: Monitoring only; no intervention assumptions; no quantitative scenario outputs produced.

scenario_description: Adjustment to bed capacity or occupancy management. Not quantitatively modelled due to missing kpi_003 baseline data.
minimum_data_requirements: kpi_003 baseline with numerator and denominator
governance_warning: kpi_003 is provisional and has no calculated baseline values. Quantitative bed-capacity scenarios are blocked. Manual review required.

scenario_description: Intervention to manage patient complaints. Not quantitatively modelled due to zero-denominator issues in kpi_005 baseline.
governance_warning: kpi_005 is provisional and has largely uncomputable baseline values. Quantitative complaint scenarios are blocked. Manual review required.

scenario_description: Intervention to improve patient satisfaction. Not quantitatively modelled as a standalone scenario family due to partial baseline and medium confidence.
governance_warning: kpi_006 has partial Medium-confidence baseline. Standalone quantitative satisfaction scenarios are blocked. May be used as supporting KPI only.
